metadata.title: One Electron Interferes With Itself
metadata.thing: the single-electron buildup: dots becoming fringes
chapters: What we skipped, and your turn
metadata.long_title: One Electron Interferes With Itself — the double slit, one dot at a time | Bear's Notes
metadata.description_blurb: In this video: the single-electron buildup — 10 random dots, then 200, 6,000, 70,000 — turning into interference fringes; why waves make stripes and particles should make two heaps; each electron's wave passing through both slits and interfering with itself; the dot histogram as |ψ|²; λ = h/p setting the stripe spacing; why watching which slit kills the fringes; and why 2,000-atom molecules show stripes while you, at λ ≈ 10⁻³⁵ m, never will.
metadata.short_blurb: The single-electron double slit, from dots to fringes. Full explainer on the channel.

beats.narration_text:
Bear's Notes

One Electron Interferes With Itself
beats.tts_normalized_text:
Bear's Notes.

One Electron Interferes With Itself.
beats.new_visual_element: Title card: 'Bear's Notes' small, title large in EB Garamond, thin brown rule, small blue accent mark on dark canvas.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Fade in series line, Write the title, brown underline, blue tick. Hold.

beats.narration_text: Fire electrons at two slits so slowly that only one is ever in the machine — each arrives as a single dot.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Fire electrons at two slits so slowly that only one is ever in the machine — each arrives as a single dot.
accumulated_scene_state: gun, barrier with two slits, screen
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] The apparatus: electron gun (left), barrier with two slit gaps (center), detection screen (right). A blue electron dot travels from gun past the barrier and lands as a tiny ink dot on the screen; a second follows.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create gun, barrier (three segments), screen; one blue dot flies across and becomes an ink microdot on the screen; repeat once.

beats.narration_text: Ten electrons in, the dots look like random specks — no pattern at all.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Ten electrons in, the dots look like random specks — no pattern at all.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Eight more microdots appear scattered on the screen; a mono counter 'electrons: 10' sits bottom-left.
beats.video_animation_prompt: LaggedStart the remaining dots of the first batch; FadeIn counter bottom-left.

beats.narration_text: Common sense says they should pile into two heaps, one behind each slit.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Common sense says they should pile into two heaps, one behind each slit.
accumulated_scene_state: dashed two-heap outline at the screen
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] A dashed secondary curve appears along the screen: two gaussian heaps, one behind each slit — the classical expectation.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create dashed two-heap curve hugging the screen; brief hold.

beats.narration_text: Keep firing, and something impossible begins to show.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Keep firing, and something impossible begins to show.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] A single highlight '?' near the screen; the dashed heaps dim.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn '?' in highlight; dashed curve drops to low opacity; Indicate.

beats.narration_text: Ripples passing through two openings overlap — crest on crest brightens, crest on trough cancels.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Ripples passing through two openings overlap — crest on crest brightens, crest on trough cancels.
accumulated_scene_state: blue arc fans from both slits
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] Blue concentric arc fans emanate from each slit and overlap in the space before the screen.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create arcs from slit A, then slit B, overlapping; '?' fades.

beats.narration_text: So a wave hitting two slits paints stripes on the far screen: strong, weak, strong.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So a wave hitting two slits paints stripes on the far screen: strong, weak, strong.
accumulated_scene_state: blue striped intensity curve at the screen
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] A blue intensity curve (cos²-striped) draws along the screen; small ink label 'waves: stripes' parked top-left, clear of the arcs.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create the striped curve hugging the screen; write the small label top-left.

beats.narration_text: A ball can't overlap with anything: it takes one slit or the other.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A ball can't overlap with anything: it takes one slit or the other.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] The arcs fade; two brown balls fly one after another, each through a single slit, straight to the screen.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeOut arcs; brown ball through upper slit, brown ball through lower slit.

beats.narration_text: Balls through two slits stack into exactly two heaps — nothing in between, no stripes.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Balls through two slits stack into exactly two heaps — nothing in between, no stripes.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] The dashed expectation curve solidifies into a brown two-heap curve; label 'particles: two heaps' joins the first label top-left.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform dashed curve to solid brown heaps; write second label under the first.

beats.narration_text: Now watch the real electrons: two hundred dots, and a faint clustering appears.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now watch the real electrons: two hundred dots, and a faint clustering appears.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] Both curves and labels fade; a lagged rain of new microdots lands on the screen with faint clustering; counter morphs to 'electrons: 200'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeOut curves+labels; LaggedStart batch-2 dots; counter 10→200.

beats.narration_text: Six thousand dots, and unmistakable stripes are forming.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Six thousand dots, and unmistakable stripes are forming.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] A denser batch lands; banding becomes visible; counter to 'electrons: 6,000'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: LaggedStart batch-3 dots; counter morph.

beats.narration_text: Seventy thousand dots: clean bright and dark bands — a full interference pattern.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Seventy thousand dots: clean bright and dark bands — a full interference pattern.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] The final batch completes clear fringe bands of dots; counter to 'electrons: 70,000'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: LaggedStart final batch; counter morph; brief hold on the pattern.

beats.narration_text: Lay the wave's stripe pattern over the dots, and it fits perfectly.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Lay the wave's stripe pattern over the dots, and it fits perfectly.
accumulated_scene_state: blue striped curve overlaid on dot bands
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] The blue striped intensity curve returns and lies exactly along the dot bands.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create the striped curve again over the dots; it matches the bands.

beats.narration_text: And there are bands where electrons never land — forbidden zones no two-heap story can explain.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And there are bands where electrons never land — forbidden zones no two-heap story can explain.
accumulated_scene_state: highlight on an empty dark band
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] A transient highlight strip marks one empty dark band between dot bands, then fades.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn a thin highlight rectangle over a dot-free band; hold; FadeOut.

beats.narration_text: Remember: the electrons flew alone — there was never a second electron to interfere with.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Remember: the electrons flew alone — there was never a second electron to interfere with.
accumulated_scene_state: label: one at a time, near the gun
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] Small ink label 'one at a time' appears by the gun; the gun pulses once.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write label near gun; Indicate gun softly; label stays.

beats.narration_text: So each electron's wave passes through both slits at once and interferes with itself.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So each electron's wave passes through both slits at once and interferes with itself.
accumulated_scene_state: translucent blue arc fans from both slits, briefly
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] Translucent blue arc fans bloom from BOTH slits simultaneously — one electron's wave — then fade to a whisper.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn both arc fans at low opacity together; hold; fade to 15%.

beats.narration_text: The dot is just where the electron is found; the stripes map where finding it is likely.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The dot is just where the electron is found; the stripes map where finding it is likely.
accumulated_scene_state: side card: dot = found here / stripes = likely here
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] In the SIDE region, a two-line card: 'dot = where it's found' / 'stripes = where that's likely'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write the two-line side card; nothing in the lab moves.

beats.narration_text: That likelihood map has a name: psi squared, the square of the electron's wave function.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That likelihood map has a name: psi squared, the square of the electron's wave function.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] MathTex |ψ|² writes in the side equation row — the name arriving as an endpoint.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write |\psi|^2 in the side eq row.

beats.narration_text: And the stripe spacing is set by the electron's wavelength — lambda equals h over p, de Broglie's rule.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And the stripe spacing is set by the electron's wavelength — lambda equals h over p, de Broglie's rule.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] MathTex λ = h/p writes beneath |ψ|².
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write \lambda = h/p under the first equation.

beats.narration_text: One electron arrives like a particle and travels like a wave — both, every single time.
beats.tts_normalized_text: One electron arrives like a particle and travels like a wave — both, every single time.
accumulated_scene_state: one more electron flies and lands as a dot
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] One more blue electron fires from the hook's gun: the faint arc fans pulse as it crosses, and it lands as a single new dot in a bright band.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Blue dot flies; arcs pulse to 40% and back; dot lands in a bright band.

beats.narration_text: Peek at which slit it took, and the stripes vanish — not because you jostled it, but because you know.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Peek at which slit it took, and the stripes vanish — not because you jostled it, but because you know.
accumulated_scene_state: striped curve morphs into two heaps
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] A small secondary detector glyph appears at the upper slit; the blue striped curve morphs into the brown two-heap curve; the dot bands dim.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn detector glyph at slit; Transform stripes→heaps; dots to 30% opacity.

beats.narration_text: This isn't just electrons: molecules of two thousand atoms have painted the same stripes.
beats.tts_normalized_text: This isn't just electrons: molecules of two thousand atoms have painted the same stripes.
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF·NUMBER] The side column clears; a card writes: 'molecules of 2,000 atoms → stripes'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeOut side eqs+card; write the molecules line in the freed side column.

beats.narration_text: You have a wavelength too — walking, about ten to the minus thirty-five meters, far too small for any doorway to reveal.
beats.tts_normalized_text: You have a wavelength too — walking, about ten to the minus thirty-five meters, far too small for any doorway to reveal.
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF·NUMBER] Below it: 'you, walking:' with MathTex λ ≈ 10⁻³⁵ m — the scale shift, twenty orders below a proton.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write the 'you, walking' line + tiny-lambda MathTex beneath the molecules line.

beats.narration_text: We didn't say what the wave function actually is, or how crystals first revealed matter waves — each is its own video.
beats.tts_normalized_text: We didn't say what the wave function actually is, or how crystals first revealed matter waves — each is its own video.
beats.new_visual_element: [BOUNDARY] Clean close: |ψ|² and λ = h/p centered; two secondary tags beneath: 'next · what ψ means', 'next · Davisson–Germer'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write both equations stacked; LaggedStart the two tags.

beats.narration_text: Try it yourself: compute your own de Broglie wavelength, h over m times v, on your next walk.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Try it yourself: compute your own de Broglie wavelength, h over m times v, on your next walk.
beats.new_visual_element: [BOUNDARY] Tags fade; equations shrink and park high; the exercise writes across the lower band in highlight.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeOut tags; scale equations up-small; Write exercise line in highlight.
